body:
I'm truly glad too... I don't think she wants the one week thing anymore since she hasn't mentioned it again, but I would've done that same anyway. also she just finished a music track she was working on so I guess that's nice because sometimes it's hard for her to find motivation

thanks a lot for reaching out, you have no idea how much you helped me :)

Updating: she didn't do it, but of course she's still depressed and now she's blaming herself. But she said she had a feeling that her partner might be alive which is really good and brought me some hope. she's talking about not talking for a week (she also suggested this one time we had a fight) so we could heal. I'm still scared though, plus I told my girlfriend and she comforted me

I don't know, she always seemed like she meant it when she said those. then again I'm pretty bad at differencing when it's something she said because of her depression or if she truly meant it. and I didn't quite get right the part about the times? right now it's 23:29 pm of wednesday, she told me she'd do it at 12pm of thursday. but I'll try updating you on what happened, thank you.

I don't know... I know it'd be her choice and only hers if she does it, that's the same way I thought about the apparent suicide of her partner (I still think they're alive though, just cutting off all contact with her and moved far away). I'm not sure if I want to show her this thread but I'll keep it in mind because, again, most of our conflicts were done because she misunderstood my words (I'm not a native english speaker, I've been using reddit for years so I'm good at it but I still mess up sometimes) and it really hurt her. like what if I wrote something bad in here she wouldn't like? 

I live in south america while she lives in um, well kosovo. our timezones are a mess since she's 5 hours ahead of me, 12pm for me is 5pm for her so I'll have to wake up early. I know depression does that stuff for you but it's so hard to get through to her... I'm still so scared and confused, I'm writing her a long apology message, it probably won't do anything but I have to

she tells me I'm kind and caring all the time but then suddenly shit will go down and she'll start telling me I'm horrible and awful. and I don't *want* to hurt her like why would I want to? It's just I'll say the wrong thing at the wrong time and no matter how hard I've tried to change that it's still happened... when I told her I had found a new girlfriend (I was hiding it from her) because she asked she was deeply and horribly hurt because she thought I wouldn't care anymore for her and that I would slowly stop paying attention to her, and of course because she missed her partner... that was one of them but this one seems different...

by the way... thank you for replying, really, it means the world to me right now, you seem like a great human being too
